t: The Bazaar of One: Forging a New Path with AI and Open Source
s: The author champions the command-line interface (CLI) and open-source tools as an antidote to subscription-based software, emphasizing AI as a collaborative partner for a more empowered, independent workflow. This approach is framed by the 'Cathedral and the Bazaar' development philosophies.
sub: AI as a collaborator and productivity enabler
The power and philosophy of the command-line interface (CLI)
Evolution of open-source tools (e.g., exa/eza, ripgrep)
